messages:
Rafi: hey all, Rafi here — first day in platform. Following the onboarding guide but hitting Forbidden when trying to list pods in `team-alpha` (`kubectl get pods -n team-alpha`). Anyone who handles kubeconfig/RBAC?
Morgan (eng-infra): welcome Rafi :wave: we'll sort this. Can you paste `kubectl config current-context` and `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-alpha`? Also are you using SSO or a local kubeconfig file?
Rafi: current-context is `rwd-dev-us-west-2`, `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-alpha` -> "no". I'm on SSO and my email is rafi@redwood.com.
access-bot: created INFRA-3011 for rafi@redwood.com. Assigned: Morgan. ETA 30m.
Morgan (eng-infra): thanks. Two likely causes: (1) your directory group hasn't synced to our RBAC yet, or (2) your kubeconfig merged multiple files and your user entry isn't the SSO one. Quick workaround: we can add a RoleBinding for your group in team-alpha, or create a short-lived serviceaccount for immediate access. Which do you prefer?
Rafi: quick access would be great, I'll take the SA option. Also fyi I accidentally have multiple kubeconfigs merged into one file and want to clean that up safely.
Morgan (eng-infra): ok creating serviceaccount `rafi-onboard` in team-alpha. Run this locally to get a token and a dedicated context:
```bash
kubectl -n team-alpha create serviceaccount rafi-onboard || true
TOKEN=$(kubectl -n team-alpha create token rafi-onboard --duration=8h)
kubectl config set-credentials rafi-onboard --token="$TOKEN"
kubectl config set-context rafi-alpha --cluster=rwd-dev-cluster --namespace=team-alpha --user=rafi-onboard
kubectl config use-context rafi-alpha
```
For cleaning merged kubeconfigs, prefer keeping per-user files `~/.kube/contexts/` and using KUBECONFIG per shell. If you want to flatten a merged file safely we use:```bash
kubectl config view --flatten --minify > ~/.kube/rafi/flattened
export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/rafi/flattened
```That avoids accidentally keeping stale user entries.
Sana: small prod-protection tip: if you ever see a context named `rwd-prod-*` our shell prompt plugin will show a big red banner. We also have a wrapper `kubectl-safe` that refuses destructive verbs when the active context matches prod. DM me and I'll add you.
Rafi: ran the token flow and `kubectl get pods -n team-alpha` works now, thanks! Also I'll move my kubeconfigs to `~/.kube/contexts` and use KUBECONFIG per terminal.
ops-oncall: note that serviceaccount tokens appear in audit logs — if you need elevated perms for demos request a time-limited elevation via the access portal so it gets logged and auto-revoked.
Morgan (eng-infra): done: created RoleBinding for group `engineering` in team-alpha so after your next SSO reauth you won't need the SA token. I left the SA token active for 8h; we'll revoke it afterwards.
Rafi: confirmed after re-login my SSO shows group `engineering` and I can `kubectl` without the temp context. Also cleaned up my kubeconfig and set per-shell KUBECONFIG. Appreciate the quick help and the warm welcome! :smile:
Morgan (eng-infra): welcome aboard Rafi! If anything else blocks you DM me or drop into #eng-infra — congrats on day 1.
